requirements.evidence: Main paths are present: routes at routes/web.php:748-749, the Queues component with the full contract of properties and methods (app/Livewire/Entity/Queues.php:53-216), Serve with a locked lastCalledTicketId, exception mapping and a rate limiter (Serve.php:277-332), members tabs (members.blade.php:461-490), navbar links (default-page.blade.php:442-449) and all lang keys in both locales. Gaps: rename passes the raw name as the slug, `slug: $this->renameName` (Queues.php:149), so 'New' is not re-derived to 'new'. The detail and confirm buttons always say ui.queues_deactivate, even for inactive queues, and ui.queues_reactivate is never used (queues.blade.php:570,619). The serve page hardcodes 'Mode' and the raw enum values (serve.blade.php:704-709) instead of lang keys. The selector label calls ui.queues_title without :entity (serve.blade.php:694).

conventions.evidence: Domain writes go through Actions (CreateQueue, UpdateQueue, SetQueueAccess, CallNextTicket), which is correct. But no tests ship with the change, against the mandatory TDD rule. No #[Validate] on `name`, `renameName` or `mode` (Queues.php:53-58, Serve.php:274-275), against the project's Livewire validation pattern. No CHANGELOG or docs update. The role check is done in the view with a fully-qualified `\App\Models\UserRole` (queues.blade.php:647). Routes use inline FQCNs (routes/web.php:748-749) while siblings use imported classes.

security.evidence: Ids are resolved scoped to the entity everywhere (`$this->entity->queues()->findOrFail`, `$this->entity->memberships()->findOrFail` at Queues.php:103,127,144,179,204-205; Serve.php:315). `entity` and `lastCalledTicketId` are #[Locked]. Render scopes accessQueue/accessGrants and hides tickets unless Gate allows `call` (Serve.php:339-342). Output is escaped with {{ }}. Gaps: `mode` is client-writable and unvalidated, so `CallMode::from($this->mode)` (Serve.php:318) raises a ValueError/500 on a tampered value. openQueue, confirmToggle, openAccess, grantAccess and revokeAccess do not call $this->authorize; grant/revoke rely only on authorization inside SetQueueAccess.

tests.evidence: The diff contains no test files at all: no feature tests for the routes or components, no unauthorized-call or tamper tests, none for the members tabs.

simplicity.evidence: Components are direct and call the existing Actions. The ValidationException-to-addError loop is duplicated between create() and rename() (Queues.php:86-93, 150-157). The reset blocks in openQueue/closeQueue are duplicated (Queues.php:105-111, 116-122). The view reuses unrelated keys (ui.members_empty for an empty queue list, ui.serve_empty for the access modal).

readability.evidence: Names are clear and methods small. However, labels are misleading: revoke is labelled ui.members_cancel and grant is labelled ui.queues_access_button (queues.blade.php:651,654). The detail modal's toggle button is labelled 'Deactivate' regardless of state. Serve.php has an untyped `callableQueues()` return and leaves `viewedQueue()` without PHPDoc. Tab links are `<a>` without href or role="tab"/aria-selected (members.blade.php:463-468).

scope.evidence: Every changed file (two components, two views, the members tabs, navbar, routes and lang files) serves the task. No unrelated refactors.

issues.explanation: The change ships no Pest tests even though the conventions require tests for all new behavior, including unauthorized-call and tamper tests for each Livewire action.
rename() passes the raw name as the slug instead of re-deriving it (e.g. Str::slug), so renaming to 'New' does not yield slug 'new' unless UpdateQueue normalizes it, which the diff does not show.
The public `mode` property is not validated; a tampered value makes CallMode::from throw a ValueError (500) instead of being rejected by validation.
The user-input properties `name` and `renameName` have no #[Validate] and the actions never call $this->validate(), which breaks the mandatory Livewire security policy rule 1.
The toggle button always reads 'Deactivate'; inactive queues never show the reactivate label (ui.queues_reactivate is defined but unused).
The 'Mode' label and option texts are hardcoded English rather than lang keys, and ui.queues_title is rendered without its :entity parameter.
openQueue, confirmToggle, openAccess, grantAccess and revokeAccess do not authorize server-side in the component; they rely only on mount or on the domain action.
The role check references \App\Models\UserRole while other enums live in App\Enums; if that class does not exist the access modal crashes. This is role logic in the view either way.
There is no CHANGELOG.md or docs update for two new user-facing pages and routes.
Revoke is labelled 'Cancel' (ui.members_cancel) and grant is labelled 'Access', so screen readers and users cannot tell what the buttons do.
Tab anchors have no href, role="tab" or aria-selected, so keyboard and accessibility support is weak.
Routes use inline fully-qualified class names, unlike the imported sibling components.

review.summary: The change adds Queues and Serve Livewire pages, members tabs, navbar links and lang keys. It routes writes through the domain Actions and scopes client ids to the entity. It cannot be approved: it ships no tests at all, leaves public inputs (name, renameName, mode) without #[Validate], so a tampered mode returns a 500, and rename does not re-derive the slug. Several UI texts are also wrong or hardcoded.
